body:
M9 THE SCALE ON THE BELT. Task file research/TASK_M9.md. Art only. Model: top tier, effort medium, Fast off.

M8 landed on master (b508488) with its boards in DesignLibrary/screens/books/ - thank you, the number-state family is exactly what C27's source field needed. Your HANDOFF block is written.

M9 fills a gap R42 opened in K23's own kit. K23 was written before the belt met the scale, so its bout states are only TITLE BOUT and PENDING. R42 now leaves two facts with no face: (1) a bout that WAS a title fight where the belt could not follow the result - title_blocked_by_weight in {winner_missed, both_missed}; (2) a division reading vacant because a champion missed the limit, which is a different story from R7's vacancy where a champion moved up. Without a mark, a build must flatten it to 'not a title bout' (which K23 and C26 both reject) or dress it as a failure. It is neither. It is A RULE WORKING - the same argument you just won for the AUTHORED chip.

Hard token holds: BAD stays M6's medical hold, AMBER stays a recoverable warning, SODIUM stays M7's champion, GOLD stays M5's verdict. No red fill, no alarm plate, no STRIPPED banner - R42 shipped no stripping ceremony, no press cycle and no hearing; the belt's state changed and that is all, and art that implies a tribunal is inventing one. Gym, never camp.

Deliver research/M9_THE_SCALE_ON_THE_BELT.md plus boards to a new DesignLibrary/screens/belt_scale/ (m9_*, 1920x1080, code-drawable from UITokens), with the rejects page. Do not edit HANDOFF.md - message me when it lands and I write your block.
